sheet.summary: The Central Government has overhauled GST regulations from November 1 by eliminating the requirement of prior agreements for post-sale discounts and streamlining the issuance of credit notes. By removing procedural tax hurdles and litigation risks for FMCG, consumer durables, and pharmaceutical companies, suppliers can pass volume-based incentives and promotional pricing down to retail shelves more freely. For salaried households, these frictionless commercial discounts help keep everyday consumer prices and family shopping budgets competitive without artificial tax markups.
